document.title: Plasmonic Coupling Simulator
header.description: Explore CDA/QCM spectra of Au nanospheres. This tool supports condition exploration, not quantitative reproduction of experiments.
input.title: Simulation settings
input.limit: Up to 50 particles (more than 20: classical CDA, all gaps > 5 nm).
input.help: Enter a preset or individual 3D coordinates, then check the geometry and surface gaps before calculating.
tabs.label: Simulation setting categories
mode.label: Mode
mode.exactMie: Single particle: exact Mie theory (2-500 nm)
mode.exactMieHelp: Calculates one homogeneous Au sphere with all electric and magnetic Mie orders. CDA, QCM, and the experimental quadrupole approximation are not used. From 2 to 100 nm, use it to compare with the close single-particle CDA approximation. Coordinates affect only the shared preview.
preset.randomGapHelp: Every pair remains above the minimum gap. The maximum applies to each particle's nearest neighbour, so larger clusters remain connected without constraining distant pairs.
qcm.scopeTooltip: Surface gaps below 0.5 nm cannot be calculated. QCM is applied automatically from 0.5 nm to below 1.0 nm; CDA approximation limits are warned for 1.0–5.0 nm.
preview.title: 3D layout preview
preview.description: Particle diameters are rendered as spheres in the nm data coordinate system. Use the wheel to zoom, drag to rotate, and the modebar Pan control to move the view.
optics.help: Presets use a fixed real refractive index. This MVP does not model propagation direction, wavelength-dependent polarization, or incidence angle variations.
experimental.quadrupoleHelp: Off by default. This incomplete electric dipole--quadrupole model is for qualitative near-infrared trend exploration only.
result.title: Results
result.description: Cross sections are shown in nm². Downloads include calculation conditions and a timestamp.
result.qcmSummary: QCM results are for trend exploration only; quantitative agreement with BEM/DDA/FDTD/TDDFT is not guaranteed. Show parameter status
history.title: Calculation history
history.description: The latest 30 completed calculations are stored only in this browser.
history.empty: No calculation history is stored in this browser.
history.referenceHelp: Each spectrum is linearly interpolated at this wavelength and normalized to 1.
history.referenceOutOfRange: Reference wavelength {wavelengthNm} nm is outside at least one selected spectrum.
history.normalizationZero: The normalization value is zero or not finite, so this spectrum cannot be normalized.
footer.note: Surface gaps below 0.5 nm cannot be calculated. QCM is applied automatically from 0.5 nm to below 1.0 nm. QCM results are reference values for trend exploration; inspect parameter status in the results for details.
validation.exactMieParticleCount: Exact single-particle Mie mode requires exactly one particle.
validation.diameterRequired: Enter a numeric diameter for particle {index}.
validation.diameterRange: The diameter of particle {index} must be {minimumDiameterNm}–{maximumDiameterNm} nm.
validation.coordinateRequired: Enter a numeric {axis} coordinate for particle {index}.
validation.gapBelow: The surface gap for particles {leftIndex}–{rightIndex} is {surfaceGapNm} nm, below 0.5 nm.
validation.gapQcm: Particles {leftIndex}–{rightIndex}: QCM is applied automatically at {surfaceGapNm} nm.
validation.gapCda: Particles {leftIndex}–{rightIndex}: the CDA approximation limit applies at {surfaceGapNm} nm.
validation.valid: The layout is within the input range.
validation.wavelengthMediumRequired: Enter numeric values for the wavelength range and medium refractive index.
validation.randomGapRange: The maximum surface gap must be at least the minimum surface gap.
validation.largeCdaGap: More than {maximumQcmParticleCount} particles require every surface gap to exceed {minimumGapNm} nm; QCM and the 1-5 nm CDA warning range remain limited to {maximumQcmParticleCount} particles.
validation.largeCdaMinimumGap: More than {maximumQcmParticleCount} particles require a minimum surface gap of at least {minimumGapNm} nm.
progress.cancelled: Calculation cancelled. No partial result was returned or saved.
progress.failed: The calculation could not be completed.
progress.startFailed: The calculation could not be started.
progress.cancelling: Cancellation requested. The job will stop after the current wavelength point.
progress.alreadyComplete: The calculation had already completed, so it could not be cancelled.
progress.streamDisconnected: The connection to the progress stream was lost.
api.largeCdaRequiresStream: More than 20 particles require the progress-enabled calculation path.
api.jobStartFailed: The progress-enabled calculation could not be started.
api.cancelFailed: The cancellation request could not be sent.
api.randomFailed: The random layout could not be generated.
api.roundFailed: The preset coordinates could not be formatted for display.
api.qcmMetadataUnavailable: The QCM result metadata is unavailable, so the result cannot be shown safely.
api.materialDataUnavailable: The Au optical-constant data could not be loaded.
api.qcmParameterTableUnavailable: The provisional QCM parameter table could not be loaded.
api.randomClusterUnavailable: The requested conditions could not generate a non-overlapping random cluster. Review the particle count and the minimum and maximum surface gaps.
api.presetLayoutInvalid: The preset coordinates could not be safely formatted for display.
api.jobNotFound: This calculation job is no longer available.
api.networkFailed: The local application could not be reached. Check that it is running.
warning.nirCdaLimit: Reduced near-infrared response is a known limitation of CDA; BEM/DDA/FDTD calculations that include higher-order multipole coupling can yield different results.
warning.cdaGapLimitation: The minimum surface gap is {minimumGapNm} nm, within 1.0–5.0 nm. Interpret the dipole-only CDA approximation with care.
warning.experimentalQuadrupoleCoupling: This result includes approximate electric quadrupole coupling. Because magnetic multipoles are omitted, energy conservation is not exact. Quantitative accuracy is not guaranteed; use it only to inspect near-infrared trends.
warning.qcmApplied: QCM was applied automatically for a 0.5–1.0 nm surface gap ({layerCount} layers; {bridgeCount} auxiliary bridge dipole(s)).
warning.qcmClassicalLimit: This pair is in the QCM selection range, but {classicalLimitPairCount} pair(s) exceed the valid upper separation of the provisional digitized table and are treated as the classical limit without extrapolation.
warning.qcmValidationOverride: A validation-only override calculated {pairCount} QCM-range pair(s) with classical CDA.
warning.unknown: The result contains an unclassified calculation notice.
